Class FlyWheel

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.velocity.SmartVelocityMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.velocity.FlyWheel
Direct Known Subclasses:
FlyWheel, FlyWheel
public class FlyWheel extends SmartVelocityMechanism
FlyWheel mechanism.

This core class holds flywheel state, physics simulation, and measurement/predicate logic only. Command and Trigger factories live on FlyWheel, which extends this class and has a full usage example in its Javadoc.

Velocity mechanisms have no max()/min() concept; use isNear(org.wpilib.units.measure.AngularVelocity, org.wpilib.units.measure.AngularVelocity), isGte(org.wpilib.units.measure.AngularVelocity), or isLte(org.wpilib.units.measure.AngularVelocity) instead.
